Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 325 AM EST Sun Nov 15 2026
 

- Cloudy skies today will clear tonight.

- Dry weather expected area-wide Monday through Thursday with a 
steady warming trend.

&&

.AVIATION...

Cold NW flow and a subsidence inversion will support at high degree 
of lake clouds holding through tonight with MVFR ceilings expected 
to prevail. Inbound high pressure will try to break up high clouds 
Sunday afternoon, but diurnal heating will again work to maintain 
higher degree of coverage throughout much of the afternoon. 
Improvement to VFR looks like it will arrive around 00Z Sunday 
evening. 

For DTW... Persistent NW wind will maintain MVFR ceiling with some 
variability in BKN to OVC into tonight and through tomorrow. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

*  High for ceiling at or below 5,000 feet through tonight and 
   tomorrow morning.
